notes: The portals are called by their names everywhere you can see them: the default panel theme reads Omen (was 'Gauge 2'), the Control Panel theme taken from Charm reads Charm (was 'OG'), and Mirage is Mirage (no more 'Blend Mode').
A panel still saved as 'OG Widget' or 'Mini Widget' is renamed to Charm once, on the next start.
